build_DDPLoss_wrapper: build a DDP-aware loss wrapper that correctly reduces gradients across distributed replicas with variable atom counts
create_DDPMTLoss_with_reduction: create a DDPMTLoss instance with mean sum or per_structure reduction and a configurable coefficient
register_custom_loss: register a custom loss function like MAELoss MSELoss PerAtomMAELoss or L2NormLoss via the registry decorator
compute_per_structure_loss: compute per-structure normalized loss using DDPMTLoss per_structure reduction that divides by free atom count
handle_nan_in_loss: handle NaN and infinity values in loss computation by zeroing them out with torch nan_to_num
